Red Cross workers provide critical needs for our communities every day. They should be able to care for their own families, too.

I'm proud to stand with these frontline workers as they pursue fair benefits and exercise their right to organize.
This young(er) man wants to remind you that it’s #HotLaborSummer, and that means there’s no better time to exercise your fundamental right to organize. https://t.co/znNi3AYCS2

Today I announced a resolution to declare the first Saturday in October “National Animal Rescue Day.” My friends at the Animal Wellness Association in Voorhees take care of strays and rescues every day. By shining a light on these animals that need homes, we can save their lives. https://t.co/qsSG0k8w6D

Starbucks continues to engage in union busting by harassing employees who speak up for their rights. It's time for Starbucks to follow the law, and for the Senate to pass the #PROAct to ensure workers’ can exercise their rights. https://t.co/mH9neXpIQK

This is why we passed the #InflationReductionAct. Starting in January, Medicare recipients will have their insulin copays capped at $35 a month, keeping lifesaving medicine within reach for millions of Americans. https://t.co/xmVmw6YvcB

Proud to see the workers at @ZeniMax_Online stand with each other. I will continue to work in Congress to pass the PRO Act and make sure all hardworking Americans can exercise their legally protected rights in the workplace.

I’m proud to stand with @steelworkers nurses as they fight for a fair contract that keeps them safe on the job and allows them keep providing top-quality care to their patients.

Everyone benefits when workers exercise their collective voice. https://t.co/gywZSRba4X

I met with @unitehere organizers yesterday to hear their firsthand experience with union-busting & discuss how Congress can support them as they exercise their right to join a union.

I'm proud to stand with @unitehere & @Culinary226 workers as they fight for a fair contract.

.@camdencountynj is leading the way in combatting food insecurity in South Jersey. 

I’m proud to have delivered more than $2.8M in federal funding for the Mary Ann Wardlow Center for Community Nutrition, which will help ensure that no one in our community goes hungry. https://t.co/pFa0l1YfsQ
I'm proud to stand with Delta employees as they exercise their right to organize. All workers should have the free and fair choice to join a union without intimidation by their employer.

It was an honor to celebrate the Maryville Addiction Treatment Center's work to help our community members achieve sustained recovery from opioid use disorder. We must continue to shine a light on this issue and connect people with the resources & treatment they need. https://t.co/jl1vyJ9vSX

As an electrician, strong union representation helped me put food on the table for my family. The National Labor Relations Board is essential to ensuring every worker can exercise their right to form or join a union, and we must empower it to do its job.

It was great to celebrate 50 years of the Nutrition Program at the Carol Norcross Senior Social Wellness Center. My mom loved the center and she would be so proud to see the difference it is continuing to make in the lives of South Jersey seniors. https://t.co/D2I9eVtwqe

During National #RecoveryMonth, we celebrate the 21 million Americans in recovery from substance use disorder and work to build a nation in which recovery is possible for everyone. Proud to work on the MOTA Act in Congress to improve access to treatment and help save lives. https://t.co/2e5UfY53mS

Amazon is pushing its workers to the brink with unsafe conditions and unfair treatment. As a union member, I stand with @amazonteamsters in their fight for fair wages, benefits, and safe working conditions. It's time for Amazon to stop breaking the law and start bargaining.

As a union electrician, I know what it means to fight for a living wage and fair treatment at work. I stand with @DCCulinaryUnion workers at @LeDiplomateDC, @RasikaDC and others as they organize for dignity on the job and a fair day's wage for a hard day's work. https://t.co/47xTdmgIYC

On World Cancer Day, we stand with survivors and remember those we’ve lost. It is more important than ever to ensure that @theNCI has the funding it needs to advance research, advance treatment, and save lives. We must keep up the fight against cancer. https://t.co/XLdPRccjJU

People seeking treatment for opioid addiction shouldn’t have to navigate endless barriers just to get the care they need. My bill will expand access to methadone by allowing pharmacies to dispense it and physicians to prescribe it, putting people over profits and saving lives.  
https://t.co/aKRjvInWqp

During COVID, we expanded telehealth for substance use disorder treatment and it saved lives. That’s why @RepBrianFitz and I introduced the TREATS Act to make that policy permanent, ensuring Americans can access the care they need, when they need it.
https://t.co/3SAk1WcX7v

We need to be expanding access to lifesaving treatment. That’s why I introduced the bipartisan Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act. This bill will break down barriers to treatment by allowing doctors to prescribe methadone and pharmacies to dispense it. We've got to do all we can to make treatment more accessible, before it’s too late.

60 years ago today, the Head Start program was created to provide early childhood education, health, nutrition, and parent involvement services to low-income children and families. Trump and Republicans in Congress are cutting Head Start programs. Supporting families means supporting access to affordable, quality childcare. Anything less harms our kids, their parents, and our economy. We must protect this valuable program from the Trump Administration’s plans to eliminate it. 
 
https://t.co/jX9KXbDsjt

While Trump pushes cuts to SNAP, I’m focused on reducing food insecurity in South Jersey. I helped secure federal funding for the new Mary Ann Wardlow Center for Community Nutrition in Gloucester Township to expand home-delivered meals to people in need.

Harm reduction works, and the numbers prove it. Overdose deaths dropped last year thanks to tools like Narcan and expanded treatment. We need to protect and invest in these programs, not cut them. Lives depend on it.

If you can fill a prescription for opioids at a pharmacy, you should be able to fill one for treatment. My Modernizing Opioid Treatment Access Act would expand methadone access, cut red tape, and put patients over profits. It’s time we modernize care and save lives.

Johanna, a local nurse, sees the fear in her patients’ eyes. For many, Medicaid is the only way they can afford care. With Republican cuts, these patients won’t just lose coverage, they’ll lose access to life-saving treatment. https://t.co/pfQyzvDzpj
